title: Rubio's 2020 intelligence committee provision and Mick's tweet

tellings.quote: 20th, 2020. Uh this is when Rubio snuck a uh a provision into you know what I'm talking about, right? stuck a provision into uh Senate in um intelligence committee language

plain: In 2020, the senator Marco Rubio is said to have slipped a provision about unexplained aerial sightings into the written instructions of the Senate's intelligence committee, the 2020 Senate Intelligence Committee report language. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff tells this from his own reading, without naming a source, while challenging the UFO skeptic Mick West over a tweet about it. He raises it to show that Congress was quietly pressing the government on the subject.
